image_url.description: URL of the event banner image

is_featured.description: If true, event is featured and displayed prominently at the top of event listings

attached_documents.description: Public documents (programmes, agendas, info packs) rendered on the event page. PDFs open in an in-page viewer; other files open in a new tab.

documents_section_title.description: Heading shown above the documents list on the public event page (e.g. "Programmes"). Falls back to "Documents" when blank.

dietary_options.description: Admin-defined Dietary Requirement options registrants can choose from per attendee. Empty/absent = group hidden.

allergy_options.description: Admin-defined Allergy options (a subsection of Dietary). Registrants multi-select, each with a Mild/Moderate/Severe severity. Empty/absent = group hidden.

accessibility_options.description: Admin-defined Accessibility Need options registrants can choose from per attendee. Empty/absent = group hidden.
